_about: Per-class method for the raster solver, chosen on TRAIN only (never dev). Switch away from the prior only with >= 5 pts margin (cost counts). Symbols/storey: experiments/w3/calibrate.py (points on 60 train drawings, direct on 260). Room classes and fixtures-from-rooms: experiments/w3/labels_train.py on 200 train drawings (artifacts/W3/calib/labels-train200.jsonl).

window.note: n60 said direct 23% vs 12%: noise; n260 reverses it
window.note_cond_prior: cond_prior = mode of window given ['bedroom', 'wc_room', 'sauna'] read from labels; table from TRAIN gold; on 200 TRAIN drawings with read labels; 2-fold held-out gain vs prior +6.6 pts (experiments/w3/cv/cond_prior.py). Classical CV door arcs and VLM crop verification were below the prior (experiments/w3/cv/).

door.note_cond_prior: cond_prior = mode of door given ['bedroom', 'wc_room', 'sauna'] read from labels; table from TRAIN gold; on 200 TRAIN drawings with read labels; 2-fold held-out gain vs prior +5.8 pts (experiments/w3/cv/cond_prior.py). Classical CV door arcs and VLM crop verification were below the prior (experiments/w3/cv/).

wc_seat.note_cond_prior: cond_prior = mode of wc_seat given ['bedroom'] read from labels; table from TRAIN gold; on 200 TRAIN drawings with read labels; 2-fold held-out gain vs prior +7.9 pts (experiments/w3/cv/cond_prior.py). Classical CV door arcs and VLM crop verification were below the prior (experiments/w3/cv/).

sink.note: rooms_rule = 1 + max(1,#bathroom labels) + #WC labels; 200 TRAIN drawings (labels-train200, runtime classifier): 70.4% vs prior 56.3%, 2-fold-selected gain +14.1 (min +6.0 over 20 splits). F's 60-drawing train sample said +3.3, dev 140 drawings +7.1 n.s. (F-label2fixture). experiments/w3/cv/fixture_rules.py

bathroom.note: R1's max1 won on 47 drawings; on 138 the prior is as good and cheaper
